purpose: Skip-and-fill 50-record batch 102: fifty independently reviewed 3.5-era reference-dependent records selected by family-level source verification from the 811-record queue. The batch raises throughput without relaxing digest locking, printing distinctions, inherited-mechanics expansion, or skip-on-ambiguity rules.

spells/summon-monster-ii-2442.name: Summon Monster II
spells/summon-monster-ii-2442.effectSummary: Summons one creature from the 2nd-level list or 1d3 creatures of the same kind from the 1st-level list. Each summoned creature appears where you designate and acts immediately on your turn, attacking your opponents to the best of its ability; if you can communicate with it, you can direct it not to attack, to attack particular enemies, or to take other actions. A summoned creature cannot summon or otherwise conjure another creature or use teleportation or planar-travel abilities, and it cannot be summoned into an environment that cannot support it. Summoning an air, chaotic, earth, evil, fire, good, lawful, or water creature gives this casting the corresponding descriptor or descriptors. Arcane focus: a tiny bag and a small candle that need not be lit.
spells/summon-monster-ii-2442.notes: Player's Handbook v.3.5 printing, digest-locked. Summon Monster I supplies the shared summoning behavior; this spell's level-list and multi-creature choices are preserved directly from its own source.

provenance.role: primary Player's Handbook v.3.5 catalog record and digest source

spells/summon-undead-ii-4279.name: Summon Undead II
spells/summon-undead-ii-4279.effectSummary: Summons one undead from the 2nd-level list or two undead of the same kind from the 1st-level list. The undead appear where you designate and act immediately on your turn, attacking your opponents to the best of their ability; if you can communicate with them, you can direct them not to attack, to attack particular enemies, or to take other actions. Summoned undead cannot summon or otherwise conjure another creature or use teleportation or planar-travel abilities, and the environment must be able to support them. They do not count against undead you can control with animate dead or other command-undead abilities. No summoned undead can have more Hit Dice than your caster level +1. Focus: a tiny bag, a small unlit candle, and a carved humanoid bone.
spells/summon-undead-ii-4279.notes: Spell Compendium printing, digest-locked and kept distinct from the other Summon Undead printings. Summon Undead I and its inherited Summon Monster I chassis supply the shared summoning behavior; the quantity choices are source-specific. This printing also preserves the caster-level +1 Hit Dice cap.

provenance.role: primary Spell Compendium catalog record and digest source

spells/summon-undead-ii-1461.effectSummary: Summons one undead from the 2nd-level list or two undead of the same kind from the 1st-level list. The undead appear where you designate and act immediately on your turn, attacking your opponents to the best of their ability; if you can communicate with them, you can direct them not to attack, to attack particular enemies, or to take other actions. Summoned undead cannot summon or otherwise conjure another creature or use teleportation or planar-travel abilities, and the environment must be able to support them. They do not count against undead you can control with animate dead or other command-undead abilities. Focus: a tiny bag, a small unlit candle, and a carved humanoid bone.

spells/symbol-of-fear-2763.name: Symbol of Fear
spells/symbol-of-fear-2763.effectSummary: Creates a permanent visible magical rune using Symbol of Death's placement, 60-foot trigger range, trigger-condition, password, attunement, dispelling, permanency, and offensive-use restrictions. A creature normally saves only once while continuously in the active area, but must save again if it leaves and later returns; read magic plus the appropriate Spellcraft check can identify the rune, and a rogue can locate and disable the magic trap at DC 25 + spell level. When triggered, creatures within 60 feet that fail the Will save become panicked for 1 round per caster level; the rune otherwise uses Symbol of Death's normal 10-minute-per-caster-level active period. Material component: mercury and phosphorus plus powdered diamond and opal worth at least 1,000 gp.
spells/symbol-of-fear-2763.notes: Player's Handbook v.3.5 printing, digest-locked. Symbol of Death supplies the symbol chassis; this spell replaces the death effect with its panicked condition and has the source-specific trap DC 31.

spells/symbol-spell-loss-4295.effectSummary: Creates a permanent visible magical rune using Symbol of Death's placement, 60-foot trigger range, trigger-condition, password, attunement, dispelling, permanency, and offensive-use restrictions. spells/shapechange-2870.name: Shapechange
spells/shapechange-2870.effectSummary: For 10 minutes per caster level, you can assume the form of any familiar, non-unique creature of any type from Fine to Colossal size, with Hit Dice no greater than your caster level and no more than 25 HD; incorporeal and gaseous forms are allowed. The transformation uses polymorph's physical-form chassis: you take the form's Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, size, movement modes, natural armor, natural weapons, racial skill bonuses, racial bonus feats, and extraordinary attacks while retaining your own Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma, and the normal polymorph equipment/body and healing rules apply. Shapechange additionally grants all extraordinary and supernatural abilities of the assumed form, while you lose your own supernatural abilities, and replaces your type with the assumed form's type. You can change to another familiar legal form once each round as a free action, but not during another action. Separated body parts or equipment do not revert, and using a form as a disguise grants +10 on the Disguise check. Focus: a jade circlet worth at least 1,500 gp that melds into the assumed form.
spells/shapechange-2870.notes: Player's Handbook v.3.5 printing, digest-locked. Polymorph supplies the base transformation chassis; Shapechange's broader size/type access, 25-HD cap, incorporeal/gaseous permission, extraordinary/supernatural abilities, repeated free-action changes, and focus are preserved directly.

spells/reduce-person-mass-2861.name: Reduce Person, Mass
spells/reduce-person-mass-2861.effectSummary: Affected humanoids are reduced by one size category: height and length are halved and weight becomes one-eighth; each gains +2 Dexterity, takes -2 Strength to a minimum of 1, and gains +1 on attack rolls and AC from smaller size. Space, reach, natural-weapon and weapon damage adjust for the new size while speed does not change. Worn and carried equipment shrinks with the creature; items that leave its possession return to normal size, and multiple magical size reductions do not stack. This casting affects up to one humanoid per caster level, with all targets within 30 feet of one another, for 1 minute per caster level.
spells/reduce-person-mass-2861.notes: Player's Handbook v.3.5 printing, digest-locked. Reduce Person supplies the reduction mechanics; this spell changes the target to multiple humanoids within the stated grouping limit.

spells/superior-invisibility-3920.name: Invisibility, Superior
spells/superior-invisibility-3920.effectSummary: The touched creature or qualifying object becomes invisible with the normal carried-gear rules, but this glamer also masks image, scent, and sound, concealing the subject from every sense except touch for 1 minute per caster level. Attacking does not end the spell. The subject emits no scent and cannot be detected by scent, blindsense, tremorsense, or blindsight; see invisibility, faerie fire, glitterdust, invisibility purge, and dust of appearance do not reveal it. True seeing can detect the subject, and mundane evidence such as footprints can still reveal its presence.

spells/spider-shapes-4215.effectSummary: Transforms up to one willing creature per caster level, all within 30 feet of one another, into monstrous spiders of one size you choose from Tiny through Huge for 1 hour per caster level. spells/sequester-2360.name: Sequester
spells/sequester-2360.effectSummary: For 1 day per caster level, a willing creature or qualifying object is hidden from divination spells that would detect or locate it and is invisible to all ordinary sight and seeing as under invisibility. The subject can still be discovered by touch or by devices such as a robe of eyes or gem of seeing. A sequestered creature becomes comatose in suspended animation until the spell ends or is dispelled. An attended or magic object can resist the initial sequestering with its Will save and spell resistance, but there is no separate save to see the subject or locate it with divination once the spell takes hold. Material component: a basilisk eyelash, gum arabic, and a dram of whitewash.

spells/unseen-strike-847.effectSummary: The spell has no immediate effect. The next time you make a successful melee attack before the 1-hour-per-level duration expires, you instantly become invisible together with your carried gear under the normal invisibility rules. The triggering attack has already occurred when the invisibility begins; a later direct attack or other action that counts as an attack under invisibility ends the concealment. Ordinary sight and darkvision cannot see you, although sound, scent, tracks, displaced objects, and other indirect clues can still reveal your presence. If you never make a successful melee attack before the duration expires, the spell ends unused.
